title: SRE ops weekly — tribe sync prep (scratchpad)
content:
SRE weekly ops sync — prep & running notes (scratchpad)

Purpose: quick prep for the tribe-level weekly sync (30m). Focus: SLO health, paging trends, top incidents, short mitigations and owners. This is a personal working doc — will copy key bullets to meeting notes.

Date: 2026-04-13 (weekly sync)
Attendees to ping before: Luca (oncall), Maya (serving runtime), Evan (infra), Priya (product infra), Olivia (platform eng lead)

Agenda (proposed, 30m):
- 0-3m: quick SLO snapshot (what burned, what looks risky)
- 3-10m: paging trends + root causes (what changed since last week)
- 10-20m: top 2 incidents (TL;DR + mitigations + RCA status)
- 20-26m: action items & owners (short, commit to dates)
- 26-30m: blockers & parking lot (escalations)

Key bullets to surface in sync: keep short, one-liners for exec-readiness.
- API availability SLO (monthly): target 99.95%. Current month-to-date: 99.92% -> slight breach risk; weekly burn: ~0.08% error budget (~35% of weekly allotment consumed).
- P99 latency SLO (inference/generation endpoints): target 500ms. Last 7d p99: 560ms (up from 480ms last week). Most of the tail increase correlates to the model-load small spikes and a couple of backend throttles.
- Embeddings SLO (throughput): target 99% within 1200ms; last 7d: 98.6% -> minor miss, concentrated in region-us-west2 during scale events.

Paging trend summary (last 14 days):
- Pages per day average: 18 -> 12 two weeks prior. Increase driven by noisy alerts from autoscaler flapping and an uptick in "node OOM" signals on inf-cluster-a.
- Alert chatter: ~40% of pages are repeat pages for the same incident (alert re-trigger on symptom vs root-cause). Need grouping dedupe.
- Top alert signatures:
  - autoscaler:ScaleDownFailure (8 pages this week) -> cause: cloud API rate limits + exponential backoff bug (see RED-2389)
  - infer-node:OOM (6 pages) -> cause: rare memory spike from specific model variant (mosaic-2-13b q4)
  - kvcache:miss_spike (4 pages) -> cause: cold cache thrash after rolling deploy

Top incidents (short TL;DR)
1) Incident RED-2345 — model-fallback-throttle (2026-04-05)
   - TL;DR: A canary rollout of model variant mosaic-2-13b triggered a fallback loop: client requests hit the canary, canary returned 503s under load, router retried to fallback model which increased load on fallback causing throttles.
   - Impact: ~30m elevated errors for hosted API, affecting ~4% of requests to /v1/chat.
   - Mitigation: throttled canary traffic, rolled back variant, added circuit break on per-client retries.
   - RCA status: draft (root cause: insufficient qps testing + router retry rules). Owner: Maya. RCA target: 2026-04-20.
   - Follow-ups: tighten canary qps limit (PR in flight: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4012), add canary-runbook section for circuit-break settings.

2) Incident RED-2389 — dedicated-autoscaler-fail (2026-04-09)
   - TL;DR: Dedicated pool autoscaler failed to reconcile due to cloud API rate limits + missing retry logic; resulted in underprovisioning during a scheduled traffic surge.
   - Impact: sustained latency degradation and partial capacity errors for two dedicated customers for ~45m.
   - Mitigation: manual scale-up + emergency bypass for autoscaler.
   - RCA status: in-review (infra + platform). Owner: Evan. RCA ticket: JIRA-2389. Complete ETA: 2026-04-16.
   - Follow-ups: implement exponential backoff + retry, add autoscaler circuit breaker dashboard panels, add synthetic canary to exercise scale-up path nightly.

Other smaller items:
- kv-cache thrash during rolling redeploys (low severity). Action: add staggered redeploy, and pre-warm cache. Owner: Luca. ETA: 2026-04-19.
- Flaky alert: graph of p95 CPU on infra-proxy shows spurious 1m spikes (alert noise). Investigate alert threshold & 3m averaging. Owner: Asha. ETA: 2026-04-16.

Action items (short, commit-style)
- Maya: finalize canary QPS limit PR and land by 2026-04-15. Blocker: need QA load window.
- Evan: autoscaler retry/backoff patch to staging by 2026-04-14; schedule postmortem review on 2026-04-16.
- Luca: implement rolling-deploy staggering (helm/ops script) and pre-warm hook for kv-cache by 2026-04-19.
- Asha: change noisy CPU alert to 3m avg and add dedupe rule in PagerDuty by 2026-04-16.
- Priya/Product: confirm SLA communication plan for impacted dedicated customers; ops note + customer success coord by 2026-04-14.

Open questions / parking lot (to call out in sync if time):
- Do we tighten router retry-policy globally or per-route? (short-term: per-route overrides for model endpoints)
- Can we add per-canary qps throttles to the router config UI? (product ask, tag: product-hosted-api)
- Autoscaler synthetic canary cadence: nightly vs every 6h? (cost vs detection tradeoff)

Quick runbook tweaks to propose in meeting:
- Add step to canary playbook: immediate circuit-break cutoff if 5xx rate > 2% for 3m OR retry amplification observed.
- Autoscaler runbook: explicit cloud API quota check step + manual override URL.
- Paging dedupe: set PD dedupe window to 20m for autoscaler alerts, merge with incident if same start time.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Copy top 3 bullets to meeting notes and highlight owners.
- During sync, ask Priya if legal/customer success had flags about the dedicated outage messaging.
- Mention the idea: 'synthetic scale-up canary' as part of optimize toolkit (low-cost small load that exercises scale path nightly) — product alignment needed.

Meeting script snippets (one-liners to read):
- "SLO snapshot: monthly availability slightly below target; we've consumed ~35% of weekly error budget — top contributors are a canary fallback loop and an autoscaler reconciliation failure. We're on track to mitigate both with follow-ups owned by Maya and Evan."
- "Paging noise is up; majority is repeat pages for the same underlying incidents — we'll push a PD dedupe change and update runbooks to reduce chattiness."

Appendix: quick metrics links to paste in chat during meeting:
- SLO dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/slo/overview
- Incident RED-2345 timeline: https://confluence.redwood/RED-2345
- Autoscaler debug run: https://github.com/redwood/infra/actions/4012
- PD alert group: https://pagerduty.com/service/ops-autoscaler

End of scratchpad. Will tidy and copy final bullets into the meeting note doc after sync.
